items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: A fella by the name of Mr. Wall sent me to this fella.

ctx.x: What kind of work did you do? There was a piece work.

What is the theater? Oh, well, he had me there. You know, I didn't work all day like them other fellas, you know. Part time. Part time, yeah. And so, so, so, other while, he, he told me all the time, tear them up. Tear them up. You don't need them no more. I said, alright. I got them all the time. I got them all rolled up. And so, I got the letter from them fellas, you know. Told me, says, we wants to see you write or telephone us or anything. I took my time and all them papers put them in my pocket. Good thing…
